title: Getting set up in your first week
objectives: Introduce yourself as a new starter and ask about stand-up
Ask where to find the repository link

courseTemplate.setting: Stand-up starts at 10:00. The repository link is pinned in chat. IT handles access requests.
courseTemplate.openingLine: Welcome aboard! What can I help you find this week?

targetPatterns.pattern: Thanks! I'm new to the team. What time is our stand-up?
targetPatterns.example: Thanks! I'm new to the team. What time is our stand-up?

targetPatterns.pattern: Where can I find the link to the code repository?
targetPatterns.example: Where can I find the link to the code repository?

targetPatterns.pattern: Got it. Who approves access requests?
targetPatterns.example: Got it. Who approves access requests?

targetPatterns.pattern: I'm the new product designer starting today.
targetPatterns.example: I'm the new product designer starting today.
targetPatterns.translation: 我是今天入职的新产品设计师。

targetPatterns.pattern: Could you walk me through the team's workflow?
targetPatterns.example: Could you walk me through the team's workflow?
targetPatterns.translation: 能带我过一遍团队的工作流程吗？

targetPatterns.pattern: Who should I ask about access to the codebase?
targetPatterns.example: Who should I ask about access to the codebase?

targetPatterns.pattern: What tools does the team use for daily standups?
targetPatterns.example: What tools does the team use for daily standups?
targetPatterns.translation: 团队日常站会用什么工具？

targetPatterns.pattern: Is there an onboarding checklist I should follow?
targetPatterns.example: Is there an onboarding checklist I should follow?

targetPatterns.pattern: Could we schedule a one-on-one sometime this week?
targetPatterns.example: Could we schedule a one-on-one sometime this week?

targetPatterns.pattern: I'll send a short intro in the team channel.
targetPatterns.example: I'll send a short intro in the team channel.
targetPatterns.translation: 我会在团队频道里发个简短自我介绍。

targetPatterns.pattern: Who's my go-to person for questions?
targetPatterns.example: Who's my go-to person for questions?

stages.title: Introduce yourself as a new starter and ask about stand-up
stages.instruction: Use the course facts to invite this task. A natural prompt is “Welcome aboard! What can I help you find this week?”
successCriteria: The learner can introduce yourself as a new starter and ask about stand-up in their own words.
hints: You can start with “Thanks! I'm new to …”

stages.title: Ask where to find the repository link
stages.instruction: Use the course facts to invite this task. A natural prompt is “Stand-up starts at ten every day. What else do you need?”
successCriteria: The learner can ask where to find the repository link in their own words.
hints: You can start with “Where can I find …”

stages.title: Ask who approves access requests
stages.instruction: Use the course facts to invite this task. A natural prompt is “It's in the pinned message. You may need to request access first.”
successCriteria: The learner can ask who approves access requests in their own words.
hints: You can start with “Got it. Who approves …”

languageNotes: "Welcome aboard"（欢迎加入）里是 aboard 不是 "abroad"（国外），发音和拼写都别搞混；「入职」名词是 onboarding，不是 "enter-job"。
